text:
model.version: {next} is lower than {previous}.
The lock is older than the previous one; it is not its successor.
when: Under the lock's name, when `ncdb model build` or `ncdb model check` refuses the change against the previous lock, and in the error of opening with a lock the database refuses against the one it was last opened with: the next lock's model version is lower than the previous one's.
